narration:0:160105631:0.text: You use the reagent on Merlin's portrait. A magic circle slowly appears on the floor.
narration:0:160105631:0.source_cn: 你们对梅林画像使用了显影剂，显影剂生效，地面渐渐浮现出...
narration:0:160105631:0.male: You use the reagent on Merlin's portrait. A magic circle slowly appears on the floor.
narration:0:160105631:0.female: You use the reagent on Merlin's portrait. A magic circle slowly appears on the floor.

say:2:1610541001:1.text: Whoa, is this it? The magic circle from the spell formula? That's amazing!
say:2:1610541001:1.source_cn: 咦，这就是根据解析出来的魔法术式原理绘制的魔法阵吗？你...
say:2:1610541001:1.male: Whoa, is this it? The magic circle from the spell formula? That's amazing!
say:2:1610541001:1.female: Whoa, is this it? The magic circle from the spell formula? That's amazing!

say:4:1610541002:1.text: Simply put, it's an alchemy solution that reveals a spell formula in the form of a magic circle.
say:4:1610541002:1.source_cn: 简而言之，这是一种能让魔法术式以魔法阵形式直接显影的魔...

say:5:1610541003:1.text: Incredible! It looks so complex... I-I'm getting dizzy just looking at it!
say:5:1610541003:1.source_cn: 好厉害！这个魔法阵看起来好复杂……我、我眼睛都晕了！

say:8:1610541004:1.text: Since the damaged part is repaired and the magic circle is ready, should Pippa and I get prepared?
say:8:1610541004:1.source_cn: 既然画像上受损的部分已经补完，用来灌输魔力的魔法阵也绘...

say:11:1610541006:1.text: Finally! Time to show off some real spellcraft!
say:11:1610541006:1.source_cn: 终于轮到我展示自己的魔法实力了！

say:12:1610541007:1.text: Princess... We should invite Princess Peggy to see this!
say:12:1610541007:1.source_cn: 公主殿下……对，我们该把公主殿下请回来，让她看看我们的...

narration:13:1610541008:1.text: Princess Peggy arrives shortly after receiving the message. She examines the restored portrait and the glowing circle on the floor with great interest.

say:16:1610541009:1.text: Amazing... The damaged part is repaired. And this circle, is it for enchanting the portrait?
say:16:1610541009:1.source_cn: 好厉害……这幅画像损坏的地方已经补好了。这个魔法阵是用...

say:18:1610541010:1.text: Yes, Your Highness. Pippa and I will now enchant the portrait.
say:18:1610541010:1.source_cn: 是的，公主殿下。接下来就由我和皮帕来为画像注入魔力。

say:19:1610541011:0.source_cn: 我还从来没见过魔法师给画像附魔呢，一定很有趣！
